name: two_armed_bandit
label: Two-Armed Bandit
description: Two arms, one rich and one lean. Each trial the rich arm delivers a pellet with the chosen probability and the lean arm with the remainder (1 minus it). Every block of trials the two arms swap roles, so the animal has to keep tracking which arm pays more. Advance to the next trial by fixed delay or presence-clear.

parameters.label: Arms (exactly 2)
parameters.help: Select exactly two nodes — the two arms of the task

parameters.label: Trials per block
parameters.help: The rich/lean arm flips after this many trials

parameters.label: Rich-arm probability
parameters.help: Chance the rich arm delivers on a given trial (lean arm delivers at 1 - this)

parameters.label: Mimic non-delivering nodes
parameters.help: When on, the empty arm still runs a no-feed dispense so both arms move. Off = only the fed arm moves.

parameters.label: Advance to next trial
parameters.help: fixed_delay = wait a fixed time; presence_clear = wait until the animal is off both presence pads

parameters.label: Presence-clear settle (s)
parameters.help: Used when Advance = presence_clear — presence must stay clear this long before the next trial
